title: AT2018cow: A Luminous Millimeter Transient
question: What are the properties of the shock and the origin of the X-ray emission in the luminous millimeter transient AT2018cow?

what.value: UVOIR bolometric luminosity and spectral evolution

evidence.quote: the bolometric luminosity as measured in the UVOIR is $5 \times 10^{42}\,\mbox{$\rm erg\,s^{-1}$}$ (cite: Perley2018)
we use the report in (cite: Soderberg2010) that from their first spectrum at $\Delta t = 20\,\mbox{$\rm days$}$

recipe.method: Point-source fluxes from calibrated SMA/ATCA/ALMA data; ALMA via imaging after self-cal

recipe.goal: Derive shock properties from SED peak on Day 22
recipe.method: Chevalier (1998) equations with nu_p=nu_a, F_p, p=3.2 mapped to p=3 constants

recipe.goal: Compare with other transients and test X-ray origin
recipe.method: Rederive velocity-energy using same equations for other events; compare IC and synchrotron extrapolations to X-rays

evidence.quote: We find that the total energy $U \approx \mbox{$\rm 4 \times 10^{48}\,\mbox{$\rm erg$}$}$.
On Day 22, we measure $\alpha=-1.1$ where $F_\nu \propto \nu^{\alpha}$, which corresponds to $p=3.2$.

not_stated_but_needed: Self-calibration solution interval and imaging parameters (weighting, cell size, image size, masking)
Method and aperture used to measure ALMA flux densities
Details of Monte Carlo uncertainties beyond input percentages
score_reason: Flux table and equations given, but ALMA imaging details missing
rediscovery_reason: Public DD data, analytic recipe, numeric results; imaging details partly missing.
